name: What causes window frames to rot or deteriorate?

mainEntity.name: What causes window frames to rot or deteriorate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window frames typically rot or deteriorate due to prolonged exposure to moisture, especially in areas with inadequate drainage or sealing. Poor ventilation, failing paint, and insect infestations can also accelerate decay. Regular maintenance, such as proper sealing and painting, can help prevent moisture intrusion and extend the lifespan of your frames.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moisture exposure, poor ventilation, failing paint, and insects are primary causes of window frame rot and deterioration.
